criterion: ROADMAP P11 stage 2, the colonnade's live settings panel (coordinator round 3 item 2, 2026-10-21). The raster comparison of the colonnade is a separate later stage.
written: 2026-10-22, before any code and before any run
design: web/colonnade/index.html and colonnade.mjs: sliders for sun elevation, sun azimuth, turbidity, exposure (EV100), samples, and an emission toggle; each change re-renders through the engine's own WebAssembly build (hash-checked by wasm/raw-loader.mjs) by running `colonnade` with those flags at 192 x 108, and shows the frame, the settings the engine echoed and its trace time. A first pass at 2 samples then a finer pass, so the panel answers quickly. The CPU module, single-threaded, on the path tracer v3 scene; no GPU and no third-party code or assets.

l1_renders.what: tests/web/colonnade_panel.py in headless Chrome: the page loads the module, renders the default settings, then renders again after the test sets sunset (sun 2 degrees, turbidity 4.5)
l1_renders.bound: both runs exit 0 and produce a PNG

l2_echo.what: colonnade.json of each run against the settings the page sent
l2_echo.bound: sun elevation, azimuth, turbidity, EV and emission equal

l3_changes.what: the frame's mean luminance (8-bit) at noon against sunset at the same EV

l4_time.what: trace time of each pass in the browser
l4_time.prediction: under a second for the 2-sample pass

does_not_prove: Real-time rates; the GPU path (the panel uses the CPU module until the GPU tracer has v3).
